svg.aria-label: Figure 1, the shape of most things I ship: a client calls the API and gets an answer in under 50 ms; the API writes to storage and enqueues slow work on RabbitMQ or BullMQ; background workers consume the queue and persist results to PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB or S3.
